docs.contenu:
🎯 Objectives
- I can name healthy and unhealthy food.
- I can talk about good habits with should and shouldn't.

🔍 Warm-up
Basket game! Put pictures of food on the table: apples, sweets, milk, crisps. Sort them into two baskets: healthy (green basket) and unhealthy (red basket). Which basket is bigger?

📘 New words & structures
Healthy food: fruit, vegetables, milk, water, eggs, fish, bread.
Unhealthy food: sweets, crisps, fizzy drinks, too much cake.
Good habits: drink water, eat fruit, do sport, sleep early, brush your teeth.
Structures:
- You should eat fruit every day.
- You shouldn't eat many sweets.
- Milk is good for you. Fizzy drinks are bad for you.
- I brush my teeth every morning and every night.

✏️ Practice examples
1. You should drink water. It is good for your body.
2. You shouldn't eat crisps every day. They are unhealthy.
3. Rim does sport every Saturday. She is strong and healthy.
4. I eat an apple every day. An apple a day keeps the doctor away!

🛠️ How to say it
To give advice:
1. Good habit: use SHOULD. You should sleep early.
2. Bad habit: use SHOULDN'T. You shouldn't watch TV all night.

⭐ Remember
- SHOULD = it is good to do it. SHOULDN'T = do not do it!
- Eat fruit and vegetables every day.
- Brush your teeth two times a day and drink a lot of water.

🔗 Try at home
Make a healthy plate! Draw a plate and put on it: one fruit, one vegetable, bread, and a glass of milk or water. Write the English word next to each food.

🎲 Fun corner
Health detective! Look at a picture of a lunch box. Say what is healthy and what is not: The apple is healthy! The crisps are unhealthy! Mini-dialogue:
- I am tired every morning.
- You shouldn't sleep late. You should go to bed early.
- You are right. And I should do more sport!

📋 Summary
Healthy food includes fruit, vegetables, milk, water, eggs, fish and bread, while sweets, crisps, fizzy drinks and too much cake are unhealthy. Good habits are: drink water, eat fruit, do sport, sleep early and brush your teeth. To give advice we use SHOULD for a good habit (You should eat fruit every day) and SHOULDN'T for a bad one (You shouldn't eat many sweets). Remember: brush your teeth twice a day, drink plenty of water, and an apple a day keeps the doctor away!

Match: We brush our ___ every day. (teeth / shoes / books)
Choose: Fruit is ___ for you. (good / bad)
Fill in: You ___ eat many sweets. (shouldn't / should)
Put the words in order: should / You / fruit / eat / every day
Choose the correct sentence: (a) You should to sleep early. (b) You should sleep early.
Your friend watches TV all night. Give him advice with shouldn't and should.
Write two healthy habits you do. Use I.
Correct the mistake: Milk are good for you.
